title: A Primer of the Drawn Bow
summary: Teaches the plain stance, nock, anchor and release of the bow to a first-year student with no qi.

title: Handbook of Nocking and Anchor
summary: Drills the nocking and anchor points of the bow for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Archer's Plain Stance Book
summary: Sets out the open stance, locked bow arm and back-tension draw for students building muscle for the string.

title: Workbook for the Untried Archer
summary: Walks a student who has never held a bow through grip, pacing, hold and a slow clean release.

title: Drill-Book of Steady Release
summary: Trains hold, count and follow-through on the string for students whose tendons can bear a full draw.

title: Treatise on Bow Carriage and Care
summary: Covers carrying, flexing and shooting a strung bow for students whose bones can carry a long draw.

title: Canon of the First Qi Arrow
summary: Shows a Senior how to thread a first line of own qi along the shaft in the draw.

title: Short Treatise on Breath and Bowstring
summary: Joins the breath cycle to the draw and release of the string for a Senior learning to pace qi.

title: The Field Archer's Handbook
summary: Gives a Senior the working shots of an archer on open ground, from cover and from the march.

title: Primer of Quiver and Reload Rhythm
summary: Drills the quiver draw, nock and loose cycle so a Senior keeps a steady stream of shots.

title: Plain Rules for the Moving Shot
summary: Sets down the rules for a Senior to shoot while walking, trotting or turning, with a trickle of qi at each draw.

title: Workbook of Qi-Lit Shafts
summary: Trains a Senior to light the shaft and head with a thread of qi and read where it lands.
